$comment: Reference list of Iligan City's 44 barangays: PSGC codes, official names, and PSA population figures. Names reconciled 2026-09-02 against data/barangay_reference_points.json, which is authoritative for PSGC naming. Geometry (lat/long) intentionally lives only in data/barangay_reference_points.json, not here, so a population revision never silently changes geometry.

population_dispute.detail: The 2024 figures below (city total 368,132; Tubod 31,813) do not reconcile with 2020 census figures found during the same lookup (city total 363,115; Tubod 33,243): the city total grew ~1.4% while Tubod, the largest barangay, fell ~4.6%. That inversion is inconsistent with ordinary growth and was not resolved by guessing — treat population_2024 as reported, not verified, until confirmed directly against psa.gov.ph.
